entity_types.name: Product
entity_types.description: A finished commercial furniture item sold in the catalog, excluding individual sub-assemblies, spare hardware, or component parts.

entity_types.name: Component
entity_types.description: An individual physical part, structural piece, hardware item, or material incorporated into a product, excluding complete finished furniture products.

entity_types.name: Defect
entity_types.description: A physical flaw, dimensional error, material imperfection, or manufacturing damage present in a component or product, excluding subjective aesthetic preferences.

entity_types.name: Symptom
entity_types.description: An observable operational malfunction, functional failure, abnormal noise, or assembly difficulty experienced during product use, excluding subjective dissatisfaction with styling.

fact_types.description: Identifies that a component mentioned in a review document belongs to the product being reviewed.
Identifies an inherent manufacturing flaw, dimensional inaccuracy, or material defect present on a specific component.
Identifies a direct physical flaw, surface defect, or shipping damage present on the product as received.
Indicates that a component exhibits an operational malfunction, improper fit, or failure during assembly or use.
Indicates that a finished product demonstrates an overall operational problem, structural instability, or functional failure.
Connects a root-cause manufacturing or physical defect to the observable operational symptom or assembly failure it triggers.
Connects an initial physical defect or dimensional flaw to secondary physical degradation or structural failure.
